items:
Experience the best of 30A at Costa Blanca at Inlet Beach, a beautifully decorated coastal-chic home just a short walk or golf cart ride to the beach. Enjoy easy access to four beach entrances, the community pool, Lake Powell, and Camp Helen State Park.

Spend your days exploring nearby scenic 30A, featuring premier shopping, dining, and entertainment. Whether you’re planning a relaxing beach getaway or an adventure-filled escape, Costa Blanca is the perfect home base for your 30A vacation.

Welcome to Costa Blanca, a spacious beach home offering a luxurious and fun-filled vacation for the whole family. The home offers 5 bedrooms and 3.5 baths, with 11 beds, a pull-out sofa bed, and a sectional sleeper sofa to hold up to 18 people. Enjoy amenities such as an inflatable paddleboard, golf cart, table games, a beautiful community pool, a 10-15 minute walk to the beach, and private community access to Lake Powell.

SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:
- Bedroom 1: King size bed, HDTV, en-suite bathroom with spa-type shower and double vanities.
- Bedroom 2: King size bed, HDTV, and en-suite full bathroom with bathtub.
- Bedroom 3: King size bed, HDTV, Jack'n'Jill ensuite bathroom
- Bedroom 4: Two twin sized bunk beds (4 Beds)
- Bedroom 5: Game and Bunk room; Two twin sized bunk beds (4 Beds) + a large sectional sleeper sofa, HDTV, Foosball game table.

Unique to this Property:
The property comes with an inflatable paddleboard, and the community has private access to Lake Powell. Take the paddleboard to the lake access, and paddle all the way to the beach. The name "Inlet Beach" is derived from where Lake Powell connects to the beach / Gulf of America through a scenic "Inlet," which is also a nature preserve abundant with rare wildlife - enjoy!

FEATURES:
- Beautifully decorated living room with an open gourmet kitchen downstairs, perfect for making memories with family and friends.
- Spacious game room offering plenty of space for kids to play or watch movies, and plenty of board games for rainy days!
- Patio: Our backyard has a patio table with 6 chairs, a gas grill, and a charcoal grill. You will also find a firepit that is great for colder days or to make s'mores with the kids!
- Pool: The community pool is a 2 min walk from the house, and it offers bathrooms inside the Pavilion and direct access to Lake Powell.
- Beach Accessories: We provide beach chairs, umbrellas and beach toys, along with a beach wagon that will help you carry all your gear to the beach.

This home is not just a place to stay, but a perfect base for all your beachside adventures!

PRIME LOCATION AND NEARBY ACTIVITIES:
Nestled in a quiet, residential neighborhood in Inlet Beach, just minutes from vibrant dining, shopping, and entertainment options. Take a leisurely walk to the iconic Rosemary Beach Town Center, or embark on outdoor adventures like kayaking, paddleboarding, and exploring nearby parks.

LOCAL DINING FAVORITES:
- Pescado: Upscale seafood with beach views and live music
- Restaurant Paradis: Delectable fine dining
- Edward’s Fine Foods: Culinary delights in the heart of Rosemary Beach
- Cuvee 30A: Gourmet cuisine on 30A
- Amichi Restaurant: Authentic Italian pasta perfection
- Asa Elevated Asian: Delicious Asian cuisine

FUN 30A ACTIVITIES:
- Rent bikes and explore scenic paths
- Kayak or paddleboard in the emerald waters
- Hike trails at nearby state parks
- Enjoy live music at local venues
- Take a scenic drive along Highway 30-A
- Snorkel or paddleboard at manmade reefs
- Stroll through Rosemary Beach Town Center
- Visit the 30A Farmers’ Market on Sundays
- Enjoy outdoor movie nights on St. Augustine Lawn

THINGS TO DO / EXPLORE NEARBY:
- Rosemary Beach: Quaint village with cobblestone streets, boutique shops, and dining options.
- Alys Beach: Elegant community with stunning architecture, boutique shops, and dining options.
- The Hub at WaterSound Beach: Family-friendly entertainment venue with dining options, live music, and outdoor movie nights.
- Coastal Dune Lakes: Explore the unique coastal dune lakes found along the 30A corridor, perfect for kayaking, paddleboarding, and wildlife spotting.
- Timpoochee Trail: Scenic bike path running parallel to 30A, offering opportunities for biking and exploring the coastal communities.
- Gulf Place Beach Access: Charming area with boutique shops, art galleries, and dining options.
- Explore Destin favorites like the HarborWalk Village, Big Kahuna’s Water Park, and Destin Commons for family-friendly fun.
- Grayton Beach State Park: Pristine beaches, hiking trails, and picnic areas.
- Topsail Hill Preserve State Park: Nature trails, pristine beaches, and coastal dune lakes.
- Eden Gardens State Park: Historic mansion, gardens, and walking trails.
- Choctawhatchee Bay: Perfect for fishing, kayaking, and paddleboarding.
- South Walton Beaches Wine & Food Festival: Annual event featuring wine tastings, culinary demonstrations, and live entertainment.
- Seaside: Iconic coastal town with pastel-colored houses, boutique shops, and dining options.
- WaterColor: Picturesque community with scenic trails, coastal dune lakes, and beach access.

What Guests Have Said About This Property:
-Guests consistently rave about their experiences at this beach home, highlighting its luxurious features, thoughtful amenities, and outstanding hospitality. Here’s what they have to say:

“Even better than the pictures!” Guests love the home’s stunning decor, spacious layout, and cleanliness. Many describe it as the perfect setting for family gatherings, group trips, or a relaxing getaway.

“Everything you could possibly need.” From a fully stocked kitchen to beach gear like towels, chairs, umbrellas, and toys, this property goes above and beyond to ensure convenience and comfort.

“Prime location with easy beach access.” Nestled in a quiet neighborhood, the home is close to Rosemary and Inlet Beach, with a golf cart provided to make trips to the beach effortless. Guests also appreciate the proximity to local dining, shopping, and attractions.

“Outstanding host.” The friendly communication and attention to detail consistently impress. Guests mention responsiveness, helpful recommendations, and thoughtful touches, such as holiday decorations and s’mores kits.

A Few Highlights from Reviews:
“The house is perfect for large groups—plenty of space, comfortable beds, and a kitchen stocked with everything you need for big meals.”

“Having all the beach essentials provided saved us so much hassle. The golf cart was a game-changer!”

“The neighborhood is beautiful and peaceful, and the property exceeded all expectations. We’ll definitely be back!”

This property has created countless memorable vacations, earning it a reputation as one of the most sought-after stays along 30A.

You will be able to access the entire house including the garage.

- Lake Access: The community offers a private access to Lake Powell.

- Community Pool: Beautiful, well-maintained community pool available for your use!

- Amenities - 6-seater golf cart in the garage, that can be used upon signing the liability waiver.

- Beach Gear- There is plenty of beach gear in the garage (12-14 Tommy Bahama type chairs, umbrellas, beach wagon, Cool Cabana tent and beach toys).
Other things to note
While this home is newly represented by our team, this residence has a well-established history of exceptional 5-star guest experiences under previous ownership. The home has been impeccably maintained and thoughtfully enhanced over the years, and we are proud to continue its legacy of refined comfort, attentive service, and unforgettable stays.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
